categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor specialized equipment. Its main product lines include semiconductor dedicated temperature control equipment (Chiller), semiconductor dedicated process exhaust gas treatment equipment (LocalScrubber), and wafer handling equipment (Sorter). These products serve critical steps in integrated circuit manufacturing, particularly for logic chips and 3DNAND storage chips across various process nodes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies such as advanced refrigeration control, precise temperature control, and energy-saving technologies for temperature control equipment. It also independently developed low-temperature plasma exhaust gas treatment, corrosion-resistant sealing materials, and combustion technologies for waste gas treatment. For wafer handling, it has proprietary technologies including automatic centering algorithms, wafer flipping, and vibration suppression. The production process involves in-house assembly with some outsourced assembly under strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic semiconductor manufacturers including Yangtze Memory Technologies, Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC), Hua Hong Semiconductor, Intel Dalian, Guangzhou Yuexin, and Ruily Integrated. The products are used in mature and advanced 12-inch integrated circuit manufacturing lines, covering logic chips from 90nm to 14nm and 3DNAND storage chips from 64 to 192 layers. The company mainly serves the semiconductor manufacturing industry within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in mainland China, with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries including one in Japan focused on sales and technical support. The company serves domestic semiconductor fabs and has established regional marketing centers covering central, eastern, and northern China. Overseas operations are limited, with minor assets and sales activities in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized equipment essential for semiconductor fabrication processes. It procures raw materials and components from suppliers, some of which are customized, and delivers finished equipment directly to semiconductor fabs. The company does not engage in chip design or manufacturing but supports the production process through equipment provision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in semiconductor equipment technologies, focusing on multi-channel, high-load, and full-temperature range chillers, advanced exhaust gas treatment systems, and platform-based wafer handling equipment. The company emphasizes foundational research, collaboration with academic and research institutions, and development of key components to maintain international advanced technology levels. It also aims to expand into emerging markets such as display panels and other pan-semiconductor fields while strengthening digital transformation and supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor specialized equipment, including temperature control units, exhaust gas treatment devices, and wafer handling machines. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers through negotiations and bidding processes. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts, support equipment, and maintenance and repair services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in semiconductor specialized equipment, having broken foreign monopolies in temperature control and exhaust gas treatment equipment sectors. It holds the largest market share in China for semiconductor chillers and is the only domestic manufacturer with significant market share in exhaust gas treatment equipment. It faces competition from international giants but has established a strong foothold through technological innovation and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 742 million, representing an 11.84% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 119 million, up 30.75% from the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 116.45% to RMB 2.86 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 252.64% to RMB 1.93 billion, reflecting rapid growth supported by a successful IPO and expanding business scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong independent R&D capabilities, possessing over 276 patents including 94 invention patents, enabling it to deliver domestically produced equipment that meets or exceeds international standards. Its products offer precise temperature control with ultra-low temperature capabilities, high-efficiency exhaust gas treatment with advanced plasma and combustion technologies, and reliable wafer handling with proprietary algorithms. The company’s close collaboration with leading semiconductor manufacturers ensures customized solutions, high product reliability, and responsive local service, differentiating it from competitors.
